newsitem.title: USA: Heartland sees Q4 EBITDA below views, Q3.
newsitem.headline: Heartland sees Q4 EBITDA below views, Q3.

text.p: Heartland Wireless Communications Inc said on Friday it expects fourth-quarter earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) to fall below third-quarter results and below analysts's expectations.
"Based on preliminary results, Heartland expects that EBITDA for the fourth quarter will be negative," the company said in a press release.
Heartland said it expects to release results for the fourth quarter and year ended December 31, 1996, in about three weeks.
The company's warning came as it also announced the resignation of its interim president and chief executive, and the appointment of a new interim chief, John Fanning.

"In an effort to improve cash flow and profitability, we are taking steps to control expenses and are currently reviewing and evaluating every aspect of our business," Fanning said in a statement accompanying the announcement.

Estimates for fourth-quarter EBITDA were not immedidately available, but First Call estimates call for a per-share loss of $0.60, compared with reported per-loss of $0.38 in the fouth quarter of 1995.
In the third quarter of 1996, the company posted a per-share loss of $0.28, compared with reported per-share loss of $0.44 in the year-prior third quarter.
